summary: We developed a space mission design game. The game is about soviet space program. It address the project by managing all material things for project, such as rocket itself and certain parts, cosmonauts and other things. It`s important because people should know how it look to manage all this things together, to understand basics of space mission programs and logic of organizing it.
details:
The storm of space (in original (ukrainian): "штурм космоса") is game about support space mission by all it need such as rockets, cosmonauts and loyalty to the party.
The game is about a soviet space program in time of space race between USA and USSR, as soviet engineer you need to lead the space program of soviet onion to victory!
Besides the technical solutions you need to solve, you should watch your engineers if they not thinking about change their side and erase them when it needed. We hope that project can show more about soviet space program which is not the most popular theme right now.
For development we used C# and Unity as game engine.
"How is your project creative?" I think the setting of soviet union of 60s is kinda creative.
The main factor we considered was our inexperience in developing games, we was very adaptable for this and also very fast changing conditions.
